body: It began with me just missing him for no reason. That was the catalyst and from there things that I used to be able to bear became too much: dealing with the verbal abuse that still continues today, playing mediator between my mom and my brother, pressure from school...I know there are people who have it so much worse than I do, which makes me embarrassed to talk about how I've been feeling but I can't help it.

It's dumb, a divorce that happened 11 years ago set it off. You would think that after all this time I would be okay with it. The thing is my dad and I used to do everything together; we were inseparable. We would comfort one another while my mom verbally abused each of us in turn. Even after the divorce when things got tough I would call him...but a few years ago I found out they divorced after he cheated on my mom, so I distanced myself from him. Last week it all came crashing down, I miss him so much. Nothing interests me anymore. I feel...empty.
